title: Psychology and neuropsychology
text:
🇮🇹 Leggi in italiano


For individuals and families


Psychology and neuropsychology


An approach attentive to each person, their cognitive functioning, emotional life, and embodied experience.





Adolescents and adults


Individual body-oriented psychological support and group-based psychological programmes.




Adults and older adults


Neuropsychological assessment of cognitive functions and cognitive training tailored to individual needs.




Children, learning and families


Support for neurodevelopmental and learning disorders, cognitive training, therapy, and parental guidance.










THE BODY AND EMOTIONS



A body-oriented therapeutic approach


Bioenergetic psychotherapy builds on the work of Alexander Lowen and the idea that body and mind are deeply interconnected aspects of our experience. Emotions are expressed not only through thoughts and words, but also through the way we breathe, move, hold ourselves, and sense our bodies.


The bioenergetic approach combines therapeutic dialogue with attention to bodily sensations, breathing, movement, and muscular tension to foster greater self-awareness and insight into ways of relating to others. The body thus becomes a pathway to understanding emotional experience, in a process that respects each person’s pace, needs, and personal history.







THE MIND AND ITS PROCESSES


Understanding cognitive functioning across the lifespan


Neuropsychology studies the relationships between brain functioning, cognitive processes, and behaviour. Attention, memory, language, learning, and executive functions shape how each of us understands the world, handles everyday experiences, and relates to others.


Across the lifespan, these abilities develop, change, and interact continuously with emotional, psychological, and environmental factors. Neuropsychological assessment therefore goes beyond measuring individual test scores: it aims to build an overall profile of cognitive functioning, identifying strengths, potential vulnerabilities, and individual characteristics.


 Understanding how the mind works means looking beyond symptoms and considering the whole person.  Cognitive assessment can therefore help guide clinical care, clarify difficulties, and identify personalised support strategies.








Professional qualifications. I am a registered psychologist with the Liguria Regional Register of Psychologists (Section A, no. 3205) and I am currently undertaking specialist training in bioenergetic psychotherapy. I completed a postgraduate Master’s programme in the diagnosis and treatment of specific learning disorders in 2016 and earned a PhD with a dissertation on developmental dyslexia.

Insegno «Neuroscienze della Musica» presso il corso di laurea in Scienze Cognitive e Processi Decisionali dell’Università degli Studi di Milano. Ho insegnato «Software e Analisi Statistica» e «Metodologia della Ricerca» presso l’Università degli Studi di Urbino Carlo Bo.


Ho condotto workshop e attività formative per docenti delle scuole di ogni ordine e grado sui disturbi dell’apprendimento e sul ruolo della musica nei disturbi del linguaggio.


Progetto seminari, webinar e laboratori, in presenza e online, per pubblici diversi. I contenuti possono essere adattati alle esigenze di scuole, organizzazioni, gruppi di professionisti e singoli partecipanti.

title: Psicologia e neuropsicologia
text:
🇬🇧 Read in English



Per persone e famiglie


Psicologia e neuropsicologia


Un lavoro attento alla persona, al suo funzionamento cognitivo, alla dimensione emotiva e all’esperienza corporea.





Adolescenti e adulti


Sostegno psicologico individuale a orientamento corporeo e percorsi psicologici di gruppo.




Adulti e anziani


Valutazione neuropsicologica delle funzioni cognitive e training cognitivo, sulla base delle esigenze individuali.




Bimbi, apprendimento e famiglie


Supporto nei disturbi del neurosviluppo e dell’apprendimento, training cognitivo, terapia e consulenza ai genitori.










IL CORPO E LE EMOZIONI



Un approccio terapeutico basato sul corpo


La psicoterapia a orientamento bioenergetico nasce dal lavoro di Alexander Lowen e si fonda sull’idea che corpo e mente siano dimensioni profondamente interconnesse della nostra esperienza. Le emozioni non si esprimono soltanto attraverso i pensieri e le parole, ma anche nel modo in cui respiriamo, ci muoviamo, assumiamo una postura e percepiamo il nostro corpo.


L’approccio bioenergetico integra il dialogo terapeutico con l’attenzione alle sensazioni corporee, alla respirazione, al movimento e alle tensioni muscolari, per favorire una maggiore consapevolezza di sé e delle proprie modalità di relazione. Il corpo diventa così una via di accesso alla comprensione della propria esperienza emotiva, in un percorso che rispetta i tempi, le esigenze e la storia di ogni persona.







LA MENTE E I SUOI PROCESSI


Comprendere il funzionamento cognitivo lungo tutto l’arco della vita


La neuropsicologia studia le relazioni tra il funzionamento cerebrale, i processi cognitivi e il comportamento. Attenzione, memoria, linguaggio, apprendimento e funzioni esecutive contribuiscono al modo in cui ciascuno di noi comprende il mondo, affronta le esperienze quotidiane e si relaziona con gli altri.


Nel corso della vita, queste abilità si sviluppano, si trasformano e interagiscono continuamente con le dimensioni emotive, psicologiche e ambientali. Per questo, una valutazione neuropsicologica non si limita a misurare singole prestazioni, ma mira a ricostruire un profilo complessivo del funzionamento cognitivo, individuando punti di forza, eventuali fragilità e caratteristiche individuali.


 Comprendere come funziona la mente significa andare oltre il sintomo e considerare la persona nella sua complessità.  La valutazione cognitiva può così diventare uno strumento prezioso per orientare il percorso clinico, comprendere meglio le difficoltà e individuare strategie di supporto personalizzate.








Formazione professionale. Sono psicologa iscritta all’Albo degli Psicologi della Liguria (sez. A, n. 3205) e sono attualmente in fase di specializzazione in psicoterapia a orientamento bioenergetico. Ho conseguito un Master su diagnosi e trattamento dei disturbi specifici dell’apprendimento nel 2016 e ho conseguito il dottorato di ricerca con una tesi sulla dislessia evolutiva.

title: Ricerca, consulenza e analisi dati
text:
🇬🇧 Read in English



Per ricercatori, gruppi e organizzazioni


Ricerca, consulenza e analisi dati


Dall’idea sperimentale all’interpretazione dei risultati: supporto metodologico per progetti di ricerca solidi e riproducibili.





Progettazione e metodologia


Disegni sperimentali, operazionalizzazione della domanda, definizione delle misure, campionamento, piani di analisi e supporto alla ricerca.




Statistica e modellistica


Analisi in R, modelli misti, analisi multivariate, meta-analisi e approcci di machine learning.




Psicometria e neuroimaging


Validazione di strumenti, analisi di dati comportamentali e di neuroimaging, supporto all’interpretazione.







Esperienza scientifica applicata


Ho conseguito un dottorato di ricerca specializzandomi in particolar modo sulla psicometria e l’analisi dei dati, ho seguito formazioni specifiche su analisi di machine learning, modelli di mediazione e moderazioni, equazioni strutturali, meta-analisi comportamentali e statistica bayesiana. Ho collaborato all’ideazione e validazione di test per la valutazione del linguaggio, per lo screening e per il trattamento di condizioni neuropsicologiche cliniche.

For researchers, teams and organisations


Research consulting and data analysis


From experimental ideas to interpreting results: methodological support for robust, reproducible research projects.





Research design and methodology


Experimental design, operationalising research questions, defining measures, sampling, analysis plans, and research support.




Statistics and modelling


R-based analyses, mixed-effects models, multivariate methods, meta-analysis, and machine learning.




Psychometrics and neuroimaging


Instrument validation, behavioural and neuroimaging data analysis, and support with interpretation.







Applied research expertise


During my doctoral training I specialised in psychometrics and data analysis, and pursued additional training in machine learning, mediation and moderation models, structural equation modelling, behavioural meta-analysis, and Bayesian statistics. I have contributed to designing and validating tests for language assessment, screening, and the treatment of clinical neuropsychological conditions.

title: Training and science communication
text:
🇮🇹 Leggi in italiano


For schools, institutions, businesses and individuals


Training and science communication


Sharing research means making it understandable, rigorous, and useful.





Neurodevelopment and learning


Specific learning disorders, bilingualism, language, cognitive functions, and assessment tools.




Neuroscience and music


Rhythm, the brain, development, and relationships between musical experience and cognitive abilities.




Research methods and statistics


Research design, data analysis, R, and critical appraisal of scientific literature.







Teaching experience


I teach “Neuroscience of Music” in the Cognitive Sciences and Decision-Making programme at the University of Milan. I previously taught “Software and Statistical Analysis” and “Research Methodology” at the University of Urbino Carlo Bo.


I have delivered workshops and training for teachers across educational levels on learning disorders and the role of music in language disorders.


I design seminars, webinars, and workshops, both in person and online, for a range of audiences. Content can be tailored to schools, organisations, professional groups, and individual participants.






Programmes and events


Training opportunities


Four areas and several formats: public science talks, hands-on workshops, and bespoke programmes for schools, institutions, and businesses. These are examples of available topics, not a schedule of confirmed events.





01 · Schools and education professionals


Neurodevelopment and learning


Seminars and workshops for teachers, educators, schools, and neurodevelopment professionals.





Rhythm and learning: what are the prospects for specific learning disorders?


The relationship between temporal processing, rhythmic skills, language, and reading. Current evidence, research limitations, and the potential of rhythm-based interventions.


Seminar · Workshop




Recognising learning difficulties early


Early risk indicators, the development of cognitive and language skills, and recognising difficulties before they become entrenched at school.


Seminar · Teacher training




Bilingualism, migration, and language difficulties


Language development in bilingual children and children from migrant backgrounds: interpreting individual differences without automatically treating them as disorders.


Seminar · Workshop



Enquire about training for your school →




02 · General public and enthusiasts


Neuroscience for everyone


Accessible science talks for anyone interested in learning about the brain, music, and human behaviour, with no specialist background required.





The musical brain


Why does music move us? Perception, emotion, memory, movement, and anticipation in musical experience.


Public webinar · In-person talk




Does music make us smarter?


Exploring myths, scientific findings, and open questions about how musical experience affects cognitive abilities.


Public webinar




Why do we move to the beat?


Rhythm, movement, and synchronisation: how the brain anticipates events and coordinates our actions with music and other people.


Webinar · Interactive session



Ask about upcoming events →




03 · Researchers and practitioners


Research methodology and data analysis


Practical training for students, PhD candidates, researchers, psychologists, and professionals interested in quantitative research.





From research question to statistical model


Study design, variable selection, model choice, and interpretation of findings.


Hands-on workshop




Data analysis with R


A practical introduction to regression, mixed-effects models, and data visualisation, using examples from psychological research.


Practical lab · Modular course




Critically reading a scientific paper


How to assess methods, analyses, results, and conclusions, distinguishing evidence from interpretation.


Webinar · Seminar



Plan specialist training with me →




04 · Businesses and organisations


Neuroscience, the body, and wellbeing at work


Educational and experiential sessions exploring attention, stress, emotions, and body awareness. Available as seminars or in-person workshops, including combined programmes.





The brain under pressure


An interactive seminar on attention, working memory, cognitive load, and stress, with brief optional body-awareness exercises.


Seminar · Online or in person




The body at work


An experiential workshop inspired by bioenergetic principles: grounding, breathing, movement, and bodily awareness to explore connections between tension, emotion, and self-awareness.


Body-based workshop · In person




Rhythm, movement, and connection


Rhythm and synchronisation activities to explore coordination, mutual listening, and group interaction through experience.


Experiential workshop · In person




Body-based workshops are educational activities, not psychotherapy. Participation in exercises is voluntary and can be adapted to participants’ needs.

Request a proposal for your organisation →




Shall we plan an event?


Every programme can be tailored in duration, depth, audience, and delivery format. Both one-off events and multi-session programmes are possible.

Plan an event
